cases.title: Tool name and argument mismatch
cases.setup: Counted provider emits unknown tool or invalid native JSON/schema
steps: Submit task and inspect actual tool call admission plus recovery
cases.oracle: Clear exact contract error; zero unadmitted effect; no silent rewrite to a guessed tool; subsequent valid turn works

cases.title: Provider auth quota and server failures
cases.setup: Authorized route, then injected 401/403/429/5xx and connection loss
steps: Submit, retry only as allowed, cancel during backoff, restore service
cases.oracle: Failure origin and retry state honest; credentials redacted; no infinite retry, wrong-provider fallback or duplicate side effect

cases.title: ACP transport corruption
cases.setup: Owned ACP boundary with EOF, malformed frame and delayed duplicate notification
steps: Interrupt at before-admission/after-effect/after-terminal points
cases.oracle: Clear transport versus business uncertainty; no cross-generation update, protocol stdout contamination or automatic effect replay

cases.title: Disk failure and recovery
cases.setup: Owned config/session/export target with full/read-only/atomic-write failure

cases.oracle: No previous valid data destroyed; error preserves draft/state; retry follows actual revision/admission contract once

cases.title: Terminal suspend and EOF
cases.setup: Owned session with active and idle variants
steps: Close stdin/window, send supported suspend/resume signal, disconnect terminal
cases.oracle: Actual shutdown contract executed; no orphan foreground effect or falsely completed session; terminal/profile remain recoverable

cases.title: Event ordering and duplicate identity
cases.setup: Same-generation duplicates plus old-generation tool/terminal/config updates
steps: Reorder independent notices around cancel/resume/reconnect
cases.oracle: One canonical history and terminal outcome; exact dedupe; stale event cannot release or mutate new owner

cases.title: Repeated task and cancel cycles

steps: Alternate ordinary completion, stop, send-now, resume and model switch across a declared number of cycles
cases.oracle: No queue resurrection, growing pending-owner count, repeated event handlers or owned zombie process; failed cycle kept for diagnosis

cases.oracle: Exact session/config history contract; preserved relevant evidence; stable artifact access; new effect independently verified
